stem: A support screen is level, but interior shoots are crowded and difficult to inspect. What is the best next decision?
choices: Reduce or reposition some shoots to improve spacing, scouting access, and air movement through the canopy
Continue filling open screen areas while leaving the crowded interior unchanged until flowering stretch is complete
Increase tie tension across the crowded section so every shoot remains at exactly the same height
Remove the support screen and allow the interior shoots to grow vertically so inspection paths reopen
rationale: Low-stress training and trellising should improve spatial distribution while preserving scouting, sanitation, airflow, and access. A flat canopy can still be poorly managed if it is overcrowded.
